mapper.select: SELECT config_key AS configKey, config_value AS configValue FROM sys_config WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND config_scope = '1' AND config_key IN ('crm.email.sendingEnabled', 'crm.email.trackingEnabled', 'crm.email.publicOrigin', 'crm.email.allowedHosts', 'crm.email.confirmationThreshold') ORDER BY config_key
